name: Simple Slideshow
description: Field formatter that renders a multi-value image field as a Splide.js slideshow with configurable transition, autoplay, arrows, pagination and image style options.
project_description:
Simple Slideshow is a fork of Imagefield Slideshow with some exceptions:

 
 Replace jQuery with Splide 
 Very small and very fast 
 Support slide, loop and fade effect. 
 Support multi blocks 
 Link image to url 
 
 Splide is a lightweight, flexible and accessible slider/carousel written in TypeScript. No dependencies, no Lighthouse errors.

 Back to top 

 How to Install 
 
 Download Splide JS then extract to /libraries/splide/. So you will see: /libraries/splide/dist/css/, /libraries/splide/dist/js/, and so on 
 Install this module as usual 
 
 Back to top 

 How to use 
 
 Create new Block Type (/admin/structure/block/block-content/types), i.e: Banner Block 
 Add Image field and set Allowed number of values > 1 or Unlimited 
 On Manage Display - Image - Format = Simple Slideshow and choose your Slideshow Options 
 Add Custom Block (/block/add) and choose Banner Block 
 Add the Block Description and choose files for this Slideshow then Save 
 Put this new Block to Block Layout 
 Repeat step #3 if you want to create new Slideshow with same Options, or repeat step #1 to create new Slideshow with different Options 
 Back to top
